description: Get the summary of one EscortFox listing by its numeric id — the number at the end of a listing link (…/anna-12345 → 12345). Returns the same fields as search_listings and the listing's escortfox.com link; contact details and photos are only on that page.

lang.description: Language of the teaser text and of the escortfox.com links. Default "en".

name: get_listing
title: Get a listing
